entries.zh: 以火镀金；火法镀金（同条并存「镀银」义）
entries.en: to gild by fire; fire-gilding (the line also carries 'to silver-plate')
entries.notes: L 明为火法镀金；M 栏混入西语 platear（镀银），R 栏双读 niāng;diàng 与 H「鏈」之音不合，故降。

entries.en: to plate (metal); to gild with fire

entries.zh: 鎏金；火法镀金（金汞齐镀饰）
entries.en: to gild by fire; amalgam gilding

entries.zh: 安金；贴饰金箔（把金箔安上）
entries.en: to set/apply gold leaf; to gild with gold leaf
entries.notes: R 作 ngān，与「安」之官话 ān 不合；M 栏 an-kim 与 H 相合，取贴金箔义。

entries.en: to apply gold leaf; to gild
to gild with fire; to gild with gold
entries.notes: 「鏈金」非习见词，R 作 siāng 与「鏈」liàn 不合、疑为「鑲金」之讹；然四栏同指火法镀金。

entries.zh: 以火镀金；（勒金）以勒压擦金法上金
entries.en: to gild with fire; to burnish gold on (gold burnishing)
entries.notes: L 后半「lumbae cumpia pero」残损难读；「勒金」为以勒子压擦上金之法，属推断。

entries.en: to gold-plate; to gild with fire

entries.zh: 鎏金、镀金箔；亦指以银箔代金镀饰
entries.en: to gild with gold, or to plate with silver leaf/foil
entries.notes: H 末字有 [疑:箔/铂]，M 作 gīn-pū（银箔）可证为箔；L「plata desfada」疑为 desflada/falsa（薄银或假银）。

entries.en: to sleep
to sleep; to slumber (literary)
to doze; to nap
entries.notes: H「寢」本义为卧睡，与 L dormitar（打盹）略有出入；M 栏另有 T99 污损。

entries.en: to lie down; to recline in sleep
to lodge overnight; to roost, to pass the night
entries.notes: M 栏「fig. de caniar」为西语注记（比喻用法）而非闽南语音写，且标 T99；义据 H「宿」与 L。

entries.en: to sleep
entries.notes: M 栏「hay」标 T99 且与「睡」之闽南读音不合，恐有污损误录；义据 H 与 L。

entries.en: to sleep like the dead; to sleep so soundly as not to wake
entries.notes: L 残损作「como g muerto, no di preta」，推为 como [un] muerto, no despierta；H 作「尸」以喻死尸。

entries.en: to wake; to be between sleeping and waking
entries.notes: L 作 dormitar（打盹）而 H「寤」义为醒，栏间相反；M「gou bȳ」疑为「寤寐」连读，无一定解。

entries.en: to fall asleep; to be asleep

entries.zh: 半睡半醒；打盹而未成眠，尚未入睡
entries.en: to doze without being fully asleep; not yet asleep
entries.notes: M 尾「aun no dormio」（aún no durmió，尚未睡）点明未能入睡；H 与 R 不完全对应。

entries.zh: 醒后难再入睡；困而不成眠
entries.en: to be awake and unable to sleep; to doze without sleeping
entries.notes: L 末「por falta mt.」缩写残损（疑 por falta de …）；H「醒不成困」与 M、R 三栏互证「醒而不成眠」。

entries.zh: 困顿中睡去；疲惫愁苦而眠
entries.en: to fall asleep heavy and sad; to sleep in weariness and distress
entries.notes: L「deapesaado」即 de pesado；H 末字有 [疑:阨/阸]（困厄），M、R 作 gō/ēu 正对「阨」。

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
